tools.name: emote_pic
tools.description: Attach one random picture from the folder of an emotion to this reply; it shows on the chat page only (the pet bubble pops on its own). Rolls the configured chance and cooldown; when it does not fire the receipt says skipped with a reason and carries no image. Only png, jpg, jpeg, gif and webp up to 5 MB are used.

emotion.description: Which emotion folder to draw from.

force.description: Bypass the chance roll and the cooldown. For testing.

summary.zh: 按概率从该情绪的子文件夹挑一张图,作为附件交给这次对话(只显示在对话页);跳过不是错误。
summary.en: Rolls the configured chance and attaches one picture from that emotion folder to this reply (chat page only); a skip is not an error.

tools.name: emote_popup_test
tools.description: Pop one random picture from the configured emotion folders on the desktop, without sending a chat message. Use when the panel is unavailable or to check the popup.

summary.zh: 不经过面板,从已配置的情绪子文件夹里随机弹一张测试图到桌宠身上。
summary.en: Pops a random test picture from the configured emotion folders onto the pet, without the panel.
